title: Shannon entropy in bits
prompt: Implement `entropy_bits(probs)` for a discrete distribution (list of probs summing ~1). Ignore zero bins. Return bits (log2).
test_source:
import math
import solution

def run():
    assert abs(solution.entropy_bits([0.5,0.5])-1.0)<1e-9
    assert abs(solution.entropy_bits([1.0,0.0]))<1e-9
    h=solution.entropy_bits([0.25]*4)
    assert abs(h-2.0)<1e-9
